public_rationale: Research documents the proposed fragility mechanism in restricted tasks. Other research demonstrates causally useful internal representations in Othello. Neither establishes whether generative AI universally lacked sufficiently robust world models for strategy through publication, or whether that deficiency explains poor strategic reasoning. The narrower findings do not settle the broad causal claim.
limitations: The research concerns restricted experimental domains.
The meaning of robust materially affects the assessment.
These sources establish nothing about actual AI use in planning the Iran war.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI has never had robust world models, so it is poorly suited to strategy, which requires a broad, deep understanding of the world.

statement.excerpt: First, strategy, more than e.g., writing requisition memos, requires a broad, deep understanding of the world, but generative AI has never had robust models of the world.
statement.document_title: In the Iran war, it looks like AI helped with operations, not strategy

from_speaker: requires a broad, deep understanding of the world
generative AI has never had robust models of the world
our_interpretation: A robust world model means a reliable representation of relevant relationships that remains useful when circumstances change.
The claim concerns broad understanding sufficient for consequential strategy, rather than mastery of one game or navigation task.
The historical component extends through publication on April 1, 2026; no starting date is specified.
The causal reading requires evidence connecting deficient world representations to deficient strategic reasoning. It does not require assuming that AI actually determined US war strategy.
criteria.support_condition: Evaluations establish broad failures of reliable world representation and show that those failures materially impair strategic reasoning under changing circumstances.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evaluations demonstrate robust, broadly applicable world representations supporting reliable strategic reasoning, or directly undermine the proposed causal connection.

evidence.explanation: The experiments connect incoherent representations to fragility in navigation, games and logic tasks. They support a possible mechanism, but do not establish broad strategic inadequacy across generative AI through April 2026.

evidence.locator: Section 1, introduction, discussion of board-state probes
evidence.explanation: The Othello experiments provide evidence of an internal representation that affects predictions, qualifying any suggestion that generative models cannot acquire world representations. A board-game representation does not establish robust understanding of the wider world.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Broad evaluations of pre-publication systems, combined with controlled tests showing whether changing the quality of their world representations changes strategic performance.
